title: Create Your Comic
goal: Every child invents an original hero and publishes a printed comic of 4 to 8 pages, learning eight AI skills along the way.
showcase: Comic Con: each child presents their printed comic to the club and to parents in week 12.

phases.title: Build the world and the story

rules: You are the author. Ideas come from you; AI helps you make them.
The three-tries rule. Improve your prompt, don't spam the button. After three tries, change your words or ask a friend.
